entries.title: Exodus 37:1
segments: As the dwelling of God in the tabernacle, and the sacrifices of his people, were preparatory to and emblematical of his tabernacling in human flesh, and by one offering of himself opening the treasures of his grace to mankind, every thing relating to them is recorded with minute exactness, and the fact carefully stated that all was done according to the pattern shown to Moses in the mount; thus indicating that redemption is peculiarly the work of God, and reflecting special honor on Christ as Redeemer.

entries.title: Exodus 37:2
segments: He overlaid it with pure gold; some have supposed that this was done with thin plates, others that it was gilt.
